outcome: incidence of transient tachypnea of the neonate (TTN)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies planned for elective LSCS between 37 and 38+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: Antenatal dexamethasone administration significantly reduces neonatal respiratory morbidity in neonates delivered by elective cesarean section between 37 and 38+6 weeks of gestation.
